errors.text_span: се покачва до около 1400 хил. кв. м. през 2008 г.
errors.evidence: The graph's peak value of 1400 is reached in the year 2009, not 2008. The value for 2008 is slightly lower, at approximately 1380-1390.

errors.text_span: след което се колебае около 800-900 хил. кв. м. до 2016 г.
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization. The period from 2010 to 2016 shows a clear downward trend from approximately 1050 down to a low point of around 690 in 2015, not a fluctuation around 800-900.

errors.text_span: Върхове: Около 1400 хил. кв. м. през 2008 г. и около 1100 хил. кв. м. през 2021 г.
errors.evidence: This sentence contains two errors. First, it incorrectly states the peak of 1400 occurred in 2008 when it was in 2009. Second, it incorrectly identifies the value in 2021 as a peak; it is the endpoint of a rising trend, not a local maximum.

errors.text_span: Спадове: Около 1000 хил. кв. м. през 2010 г.
errors.evidence: The point in 2010 is not a 'спад' (low point/trough). It is a point on a steep decline from the 2009 peak. The local troughs are in 2015 (around 690) and the plateau in 2017-2018 (at 700).
The description fails to mention the circular markers present at each data point along the line, which was a requirement of the prompt ('формата на използвания маркер (ако има такъв)').

errors.text_span: Тя започва на около 850 хил. кв. м. през 2005 г.
errors.evidence: The starting value in 2005 is visibly closer to 830, making the approximation of 850 slightly inaccurate.

errors.text_span: достигайки около 1100 хил. кв. м. през 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The final value in 2021 is visibly closer to 1150 than 1100.
